k-12.title: Ngubani owenzayo? Izihloko ezishiyiweyo
k-12.goal: Fumana ukuba kubhekiswa kubani kwincoko apho izihloko zishiyiweyo, ufumane umgca oseleyo ungacacanga, ubhale incoko yakho emfutshane apho isalathiso sisabonisa ukuba ngubani.
k-12.material:
수미 kunye 태호 basebenza kwiofisi enye. Bazama ukufikelela 부장님 yabo (intloko yesebe). 비서 ithetha unobhala wentloko.

수미: 부장님한테 전화했어요?
태호: 네, 했는데 안 받으세요.
수미: 비서한테는 물어봤어요?
태호: 네, 물어봤더니 지금 회의 중이시래요.
k-12.s.s1.r.b: Isithethi asisayi kusebenzisa isiphelo sembeko -시- ngokwaso.
k-12.s.s1.r.c: 수미 akangomntu othethwa ngaye; isiphelo sembeko sikhomba nasekuphakameni.
k-12.s.s1.r.d: Unobhala nguye ophendulileyo, hayi umntu osentlanganisweni.
k-12.s.s1.explain: '회의 중이시래요' iqulathe imbeko -시-, ephawula isihloko njengomntu omele ahlonitshwe: 부장님.
k-12.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ukuba ngubani abuzwe ngu-태호 kumgca wangaphambili.
k-12.s.s2.r.b: 태호 ubuze unobhala, hayi intloko, kwaye intloko yeyo ixakekile ekudibaneni.
k-12.s.s2.explain: '물어봤더니 ... -래요' = 'xa ndibuzile, (bathe) ...'. Umntu obuzwe kumgca wangaphambili ngu-비서.
k-12.s.s3.prompt: Kwenye incoko, umgca omnye awucaci ukuba kubhekiswa kubani, nangona isenzi sikwindlela yembeko, kuba bakho abantu ababini abahlonitshwayo encokweni. Wukhethe.
k-12.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana abantu encokweni ababeya kuthethwa ngabo nge--시-.
k-12.s.s3.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, buza ukuba isihloko sibizwa ngegama okanye sinokuqikelelwa kuphela.
k-12.s.s3.explain: '연락하신대요' ine--시-, ngoko umntu uhlonitshwa, kodwa zombini 사장님 kunye 팀장님 ziyafaneleka kwaye imigca yangaphambili ibabiza kunye. Umfundi akakwazi ukwazi ukuba ngubani oya kutsalela umnxeba kwakhona; ukongeza isihloko ('사장님이 ...' okanye '팀장님이 ...') kuyayilungisa.
k-12.s.s4.prompt: Yenza incoko yakho yemigca emibini ngesiKorean (intetho enentlonipho) evela kwimeko yesikolo okanye yomsebenzi: umntu ubuza oko utitshala okanye umphathi akuthethileyo okanye akwenzileyo, kwaye impendulo ishiya isihloko kodwa isiphelo sembeko sisabonisa ukuba ngubani.
k-12.s.s4.hint.0: Khetha umntu ofanele imbeko, njenge-선생님 okanye 부장님.
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umfundi unokwazi ukuba ngubani owenzileyo ngaphandle kwesihloko?
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndisebenzise imbeko kumntu ofanele yona kuphela?

k-01.title: 'Hayi' engaze ithi hayi
k-01.goal: Qikelela kwincoko emfutshane kakhulu ukuba impendulo ethambileyo ikwala usuku olunye kodwa hayi lonke icebo, ukhombe ubungqina, uze ubhale ukwala kwakho okuthambileyo nokunye ukhetho.
k-01.material:
Abafundi ababini, 민수 kunye ne-수진, bathumelelana imiyalezo. Basebenzisa intetho ehloniphekileyo ye--요 komnye nomnye. (😅 = ubuso obunethontsi elincinci lokubila, ukuncuma okungathandekiyo.)

민수: 토요일에 영화 볼까요?
수진: 토요일은 좀… 😅
민수: 그럼 일요일은요?
수진: 일요일은 좋아요!
k-01.prereq.1: Uyazi iziphelo ezisisiseko ze -아요/어요 namagama eentsuku zeveki
k-01.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umgca olandelayo ovela ku-민수: uphendula njani?
k-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qaphela ukuba 수진 akayithethi 네 okanye 아니요. Yintoni awayishiya ingagqitywanga?
k-01.s.s1.o.a: UMgqibelo awulungile kuye; uyaluala olo suku.
k-01.s.s1.r.b: '좀…' ehamba ithe nca kunye ne-emoji ephazamisayo kukuthandabuza, hayi uvuyo. Jonga indlela umgca olandelayo (그럼 일요일은요?) uphendula ngayo.
k-01.s.s1.o.c: Akafuni kwaphela ukubukela imuvi kunye ne-민수.
k-01.s.s1.r.c: Oku kufunda kakhulu kunokuba kukho. Umgca wakhe wokugqibela, 일요일은 좋아요!, ubonisa ukuba usafuna ukuya.
k-01.s.s1.r.d: Uliphendula ngqo ngokubiza usuku, ngoko ulaqondile.
k-01.s.s1.explain: '좀…' ithambisa ukwaliwa ukuze kungabikho mntu kufuneka athi '안 돼요'. Uphawu lwesihloko -은 kwi-'토요일은' lukhetha uMgqibelo, yaye 민수 uphendula ngokunikela usuku olunye.
k-01.s.s2.prompt: Zeziphi iziqwenga zobungqina ezibonisa ukuba 수진 usafuna ukubona imuvi? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
k-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana imigca apho athi into entle.
k-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa oko akubizayo kwi '토요일은 좀…' noko akubizayo kwi '일요일은 좋아요!'.
k-01.s.s2.o.a: Uphendula '일요일은 좋아요!' xa 민수 enikela iCawa.
k-01.s.s2.r.b: '좀' ithambisa ukwaliwa; ayithi nto ngokuba uyalithanda na isicwangciso.
k-01.s.s2.r.c: I-emoji ibonisa ukuba uziva engakhululekanga, hayi ukuba ufuna imuvi.
k-01.s.s2.o.d: Wathi '토요일은', ebiza usuku kuphela, hayi imuvi ngokwayo.
k-01.s.s2.explain: Akayiali imuvi. Uyala kuphela uMgqibelo (토요일은), yaye uyamkela iCawa.
k-01.s.s2.acc.0: Ukucaphula kuphela ubungqina obucace gqitha (uyamkela iCawa) kuyafaneleka; d yongeza ukuba ubiza usuku kuphela, hayi ifilimu.
k-01.s.s3.prompt: Umhlobo wakho weklasi 민수 ukumema ukuba nityele ngaphandle ngoMgqibelo, kodwa awukwazi ukuya. Phendula ngesiKorean ngentetho ye -요: ungatshongo '싫어요', thambisa ukwaliwa, uze unikele usuku olunye.
k-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokuthi uxolo okanye ukuba yinto embi, emva koko ubize uMgqibelo.
k-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yithi uxolo okanye unike isizathu esifutshane, emva koko ugqibele ngombuzo ocebisa usuku olwahlukileyo.
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba impendulo yam icacisa ukuba andikwazi ukuya ngoMgqibelo?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba 민수 wayeya kwazi ukuba enze ntoni emva koko?
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Ifutshane yaye ithambile; isebenzisa 좀 yaye inikela usuku.
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inika isizathu endaweni ye-좀, emva koko icebisa iCawa.

k-02.title: Ukuthetha nomrhwebi wevenkile
k-02.goal: Qaphela ukuba ngemigca yomthengi emi iqhelekile kakhulu ukuthetha nomntu ongamaziyo evenkileni, gqiba isizathu, uze uyibhale ngokuhloniphekileyo.
k-02.material: Kwivenkile yeziqhamo. Umrhwebi nomthengi abazani. Bobabini babonakala bengabantu abadala.
k-02.s.s1.prompt: Umgca omnye okanye ngaphezulu womthengi uvakala uqhelekile kakhulu ukuthetha nomrhwebi ongamaziyo. Khetha omnye wayo.
k-02.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga isiphelo somgca ngamnye womthengi: ngaba iphela nge -요/-습니다?
k-02.s.s1.explain: '얼마야?' kunye '줘' zi-반말 (intetho eqhelekileyo). Abantu abangaziyaniyo badla ngokusebenzisa intetho ehloniphekileyo omnye komnye: '얼마예요?' kunye '주세요'.
k-02.s.s2.prompt: Umrhwebi usebenzisa intetho ehloniphekileyo (-요) kumthengi. Ngaba umthengi angaphendula ngentetho eqhelekileyo (반말) ngenxa yoko?
k-02.s.s2.hint.0: Buza: ngaba aba bantu bambini bayazana?
k-02.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba umthengi ngumntu ongamaziyo ebhasini. Wawuya kusebenzisa inqanaba lintetho elinjani?
k-02.s.s2.o.a: Hayi. Abangaziyaniyo basebenzisa intetho ehloniphekileyo kumacala omabini; umrhwebi uhloniphekile njengenxalenye yomsebenzi.
k-02.s.s2.o.b: Ewe. Bobabini ngabantu abadala abathethayo, ngoko intetho eqhelekileyo ilungile.
k-02.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba ngabantu abadala akwenzi ukuba intetho eqhelekileyo ilunge; nomntu ongamaziyo yeyona ndlela ikhuselekileyo kukusebenzisa intetho ehloniphekileyo kumacala omabini.
k-02.s.s2.o.c: Ewe. Umthengi uyahlawula, ngoko umthengi uyagqiba.
k-02.s.s2.r.c: Ukuhlawula akutshintshi ulwalamano. Abathengi nabo badla ngokusebenzisa intetho ehloniphekileyo.
k-02.s.s2.o.d: Hayi, kodwa kuphela kuba umrhwebi mdala kakhulu.
k-02.s.s2.r.d: Ubudala bunokubalulekile, kodwa apha ubudala abunikwanga. Isizathu esiphambili kukuba abangaziyaniyo.
k-02.s.s2.explain: Eyona ndlela iqhelekileyo phakathi kwabangaziyaniyo yintetho ehloniphekileyo kumacala omabini. Kwiivenkile, intetho ehloniphekileyo yomrhwebi lulwimi lwenkonzo kwaye ayinikezi mthengi ilungelo lokusebenzisa 반말.
k-02.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale imigca emibini eqhelekileyo yomthengi ('이 귤 얼마야?' kunye '그럼 두 봉지 줘.') ukuze ihambelane nale meko.
k-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tshintsha iziphelo zemigca yomibini ibe yifom ehloniphekileyo.
k-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngoko ukuthethayo xa uodola ekafeni.
k-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba izivakalisi zam zombini ziphela ngembeko?
k-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umrhwebi endingamaziyo wayeya kuziva ehlonitshiwe?

k-03.title: Ngaba amaxesha ayahambelana?
k-03.goal: Thelekisa isaziso esifutshane nomyalezo womhlobo, uqaphele ukuba amaxesha ahambelani, uze ubuze umbuzo ocacisayo olungileyo endaweni yokuvuma.
k-03.material:
Namhlanje yiLwesihlanu, 10월 23일. Isikolo sakho sinesaziso yaye umhlobo wakho ukuthumelele umyalezo.

[소풍 안내]
- 날짜: 10월 24일 토요일
- 장소: 한강공원
- 버스 출발: 아침 8시 30분 (학교 앞)
- 준비물: 도시락, 물, 편한 신발

친구 문자: "내일 7시에 학교 앞에서 만나요! 도시락 꼭 가져와요."
k-03.thinking.1: Ukugqiba ukuba ubuze ntoni phambi kokuphendula
k-03.s.s1.prompt: Phambi kokuphendula, sesiphi umbuzo oluncedo kakhulu ukubuza umhlobo wakho?
k-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana onke amaxesha kwisaziso nasemyalezweni, uze uwathelekise.
k-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sesiphi umbuzo obuza ngento ongayaziyo esazisweni?
k-03.s.s1.r.a: Isaziso sele sikuxelela ixesha lebhasi, ngoko lo mbuzo awuyongezi nto.
k-03.s.s1.r.c: Umyalezo uthi kuphela zisa ibhokisi yesidlo sasemini; apho unokuyithenga akusiyo ingxaki.
k-03.s.s1.r.e: Ukubuza AM okanye PM kunokuba lilinyathelo lokuqala, kodwa ibhasi ihamba ekuseni, ngoko ukudibana ebusuku akunangqondo. Ingxaki yenene kukwahlukana phakathi kwexesha lebhasi nexesha lokudibana.
k-03.s.s1.explain: Imithombo emibini iyahluka (isaziso sithi ibhasi ihamba ngo-8:30, umyalezo uthi dibana ngo-7:00). Owona mbuzo ulungileyo ukhomba umahluko ukuze umhlobo achaze.
k-03.s.s1.acc.0: Ukubuza AM/PM kukucaciswa kokuqala okufanelekileyo, kodwa akukabonisi ukuba uyiqaphele ixesha lebhasi lika-8:30.
k-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhalela umhlobo wakho umbuzo wakho ngesiKorean (intetho yobuhlobo ye -요). Khankanya zombini ixesha lebhasi (okanye isaziso) nokudibana ngo-7:00.
k-03.s.s2.hint.0: Beka ixesha lebhasi nexesha lomhlobo wakho ecaleni komnye kwisivakalisi esinye.
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umbuzo wam ubonisa ukuba ndiqaphele ukuba amaxesha ayahluka?
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umhlobo wam wayenokuphendula ngesivakalisi esinye esifutshane?

k-04.title: Ukuthenga ngemida
k-04.goal: Guqula umyalezo omfutshane onamagama alahlekileyo ube yimida echanekileyo, ufumane iibhasikidi ezininzi zokuthenga ezizanelisayo, uze uxele enye ngesiKorean.
k-04.material:
Umhlobo wakho ukuthumelela umyalezo phambi kokuba uye emarikeni:

"시장에 가요? 그럼 사과랑 귤 좀 사 와요. 만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요. 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요. 모두 5봉지 이상이요."

[가격표]
사과 한 봉지: 2,000원
귤 한 봉지: 1,000원
k-04.prereq.2: Uzibonile -까지 (ukuya kuthi ga), -보다 (kune) kunye 이상 (eli nani okanye ngaphezulu); zichazwe kumacebiso
k-04.s.s1.prompt: I '만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요' ikuxelela ntoni?
k-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba umhlobo wayeya kuphazamiseka ukuba uchithe i-8,000 won.
k-04.s.s1.o.a: Unokuchitha ukuya kuthi ga kwi-10,000 won kodwa hayi ngaphezulu.
k-04.s.s1.r.c: Oko kuya kuba kuchasene: ubuncinane endaweni yobona bukhulu.
k-04.s.s1.r.d: Amaxabiso akuluhlu lwamaxabiso; 만 원 yimali onokuyisebenzisa.
k-04.s.s1.explain: '-까지' iphawula umda ophezulu: ukuya kuthi ga kwi-10,000 won, kwaye ukuchitha kancinci kulungile.
k-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana iibhasikidi ezi-3 ezihambelana neemeko zonke zomyalezo, nganye inenani elahlukileyo leengxowa zeeapile. a = iingxowa zeeapile, g = iingxowa zeetanjarini.
k-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala imeko ngamazwi akho kuqala: '-보다 많아야 해요' = kufuneka zibe ngaphezu kwe; '이상' = eli nani okanye ngaphezulu.
k-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zama a = 1 uze unyuse g kude kube isixa sifikelela kwiingxowa ezi-5.
k-04.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola imali ekugqibeleni: 2,000 × a + 1,000 × g, emva koko tshintsha a.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Umyalezo ucela zombini 사과 kunye 귤 (ubuncinane ingxowa enye nganye).
k-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요: iingxowa zeetanjarini kufuneka zibe ngaphezu kweengxowa zeeapile.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c3: 모두 5봉지 이상: ubuncinane iingxowa ezi-5 ngokubanzi.
k-04.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo iiapile ezi-1 + iitanjarini ezi-4 = 6,000 won; 2 + 3 = 7,000 won; 3 + 4 = 10,000 won. Iibhasikidi ezininzi ziyahambelana kuba umyalezo unika imida, hayi i-odolo enye echanekileyo.
k-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha IBHASIKIDI ENYE yakho uthumelele umhlobo wakho umyalezo omfutshane ngesiKorean (-요 ehloniphekileyo) uthi uthenge iingxowa ezingaphi zesiqhamo ngasinye nesixa sonke.
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa ibhasikidi enye ekuphuma ngasentla: ngawaphi amanani amabini?
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chaza inani leeapile, inani leetanjarini, emva koko isixa sonke nge-won.
k-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba amanani akumyalezo wam ahambelana nebhasikidi enye endiyakhileyo?
k-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isixa sonke silungile (2,000 × iiapile + 1,000 × iitanjarini)?

k-05.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
k-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye, ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
k-05.title: Ummelwane uthetha ntoni?
k-05.goal: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo isikhalazo esingathanga ngqo njengoko inxalenye engakumbi yencoko ivela, uze ubhale inqaku elifanelekileyo kummelwane.
k-05.material: Uhlala kwi-apartment 302. Umntu omdala ovela kwi-apartment 202 (umgangatho ongezantsi), ongamaziyo kakuhle, ukumisa kwi-elevator.
k-05.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya intsingiselo xa incoko eyongezelelweyo ityhilwa
k-05.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga iziphelo zezivakalisi (…, -서요, -는데) ukufumana oko kushiywe kungathethwanga.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kweli nqanaba zombini incoko encinci kunye nesalathiso sengxaki ziyenzeka, kodwa '들려서요…' iphela ngesizathu yaye ishiya isiphumo singathethwanga, oko kudla ngokuba luphawu lwesikhalazo.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho nto kwisivakalisi ecebisa ukufuduka; ummelwane ofuna oko wayeya kuba ngqo ngakumbi.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho lwimi lomnqweno (njenge-놀러 오세요). Isivakalisi sithetha ngeendlela ezidibana nesiphazamisa othethayo.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Usana lukabani, yaye ummelwane unethemba lantoni?
k-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Umthethi ushiya umnini, kodwa usana olubuyayo ngenxa yengxolo evela phezulu lolomamelwane. Banethemba lengxolo encinci, hayi lokuba uhambe.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Usana lwabo; banethemba lokuba ingxolo yangokuhlwa iya kunciphisa
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Usana lolo lubuyayo ngenxa yesandi esivela phezulu, ngoko lolo mthethi, hayi lwakho.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ithemba lomthethi limalunga nengxolo, hayi indawo ohlala kuyo; akukho phawu lokuba bafuna uhambe.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Iinkcukacha ngosana (자는데, 깨서요) sisizathu sesicelo, ngoko oku kungaphezulu kwencoko nje.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.after: '아니에요, 감사해요' kunye '좀 부탁드려요' zibonisa isicelo esithe cwaka, esinembeko esinqunyelwe emva kwe-9 ebusuku.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Akacatshukanga; wamkela icebo lakho kwaye ucela uzolo emva kwe-9
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: '아니에요, 감사해요' lithoni ethe cwaka, enombulelo, hayi enomsindo.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ufuna abantwana bayeke ukubaleka ngamaxesha onke
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Bacela kuphela emva kwe-9 ('9시 이후만'), hayi ukungabaleki ngamaxesha onke.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Basathi '부탁드려요', ngoko uzolo emva kwe-9 lubalulekile kubo.
k-05.s.s1.reflect: Qaphela indlela isikhalazo esinokwakhiwa ngayo ngemikhondo emincinci: kuqala isivakalisi esingagqitywanga, emva koko isizathu, emva koko isicelo. Ukuba nembeko akuthethi ukuba akukho sicelo.
k-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngosuku olulandelayo ushiya inqaku elifutshane (쪽지) emnyango womamelwane. Xolisa, utsho oko uza kukwenza, ubulele. Sebenzisa intetho enembeko.
k-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngenombolo yeflethi yakho, emva koko uxolo.
k-05.s.s2.hint.1: Khankanya ixesha (njenge-9시 이후) okanye ukuziphatha oza kukutshintsha.

k-10.title: Likhulu kangakanani eli cebiso?
k-10.goal: Hlaziya ukufunda kwakho isicelo somsebenzi esithambileyo njengoko imiyalezo emininzi ivela, uze ubhale impendulo eqinisekisa oko uza kukwenza nokuba nini.
k-10.material: 팀장 yakho (inkokeli yethimba, umphathi wakho) ikuthumela imiyalezo kwincoko yenkampani. Funda omnye ngexesha.
k-10.s.s1.prompt: Funda umyalezo ngamnye, ukhethe ukuba uwuqonda njani, uze uqhubeke.
k-10.s.s1.hint.0: Gqiba usebenzisa imiyalezo oyibonileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kuphela.
k-10.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba ngubani othetha nabani nokuba umphathi uhlala elindele ntoni.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ovela komphathi, '혹시 ... 주실 수 있을까요?' ihlala iyindlela enentlonipho yokucela into yenziwe. Ukuyifunda ngokoqobo njengombuzo ngexesha lakho lasimahla kuyenzeka ekuqaleni, kodwa imiyalezo elandelayo ibonisa ukuba sisicelo sokwenene.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Isicelo esithambileyo kodwa sokwenene esivela komphathi; kulindeleke ukuba usenze
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Isicelo somphathi sinqabile ukuba ngongazibophelelanga; izithambisi (혹시, 시간 되면) zigcina nje intlonipho.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho gama elifana ne-지금 okanye 당장 livelayo, ngoko asingomyalelo wangoko.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.after: '-까지만 보면 돼요' ibeka umda: phambi kwentlanganiso yangomso. '급한 건 아니고요' ithetha nje ukuba akukho ngxamiseko.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: '내일 오전 회의 전까지만' ibeka umda ongqongqo kune-'kule veki'.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '급한 건 아니고요' ithi ayikho ngxamisekileyo, ngoko hayi ngoku nje.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.after: '더 좋고요' ngumnqweno, hayi umthetho, kodwa iimfuno zomphathi ziyabalulekile. Cwangcisa ukujonga namhlanje okanye ubuze ngentlonipho ukuba umnqweno unamandla kangakanani.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ungenzi nto de kuse, umhla wokugqibela yintlanganiso
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Oku kuhlangabezana nomhla wokugqibela otshiwo kodwa kuyayityeshela imfuno entsha yanamhlanje ('더 좋고요'); umnqweno womphathi uhlala ubalwa.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Zama ukujonga phambi kokuhamba namhlanje, ugqibe phambi kwentlanganiso
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yityeshele umyalezo omtsha, umhla wokugqibela wokuqala wesona sokwenene
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Umyalezo omtsha wongeza kowokuqala; awurhoxisi, kwaye umnqweno womphathi uyabalulekile.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Phendula ubuze ukuba ukujonga namhlanje kuyafuneka okanye kwamkelekile nje
k-10.s.s1.reflect: Isicelo esithambileyo esivela komphathi sihlala silindeleke ukuba senziwe. Imiyalezo yamva ihlala yongeza umhla wokugqibela wokwenene; isivakalisi esithambileyo kakhulu asifani ne-'ngongazibophelelanga'.
k-10.s.s2.prompt: Phendula ku-팀장님 kwincoko ngentetho enentlonipho. Qinisekisa ukuba uza kukwenza kwaye uthi nini.
k-10.s.s2.hint.1: Biza amaxesha amabini: 오늘 kunye nentlanganiso.
k-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndicacisa ngokucacileyo oko ndiza kukwenza nokuba nini?
k-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba inkokeli yethimba iya kwaneliseka sesi siphendulo?

k-06.title: Umhlobo wam angayifumana imbuyekezo?
k-06.goal: Dibanisa isaziso, itafile nomyalezo womhlobo ukugqiba ukuba imbuyekezo ingakanani, khomba ubungqina obufunekayo, uze uchaze komhlobo ngesiKorea.
k-06.s.s1.hint.0: Sebenza ingxenye yesithathu nesiqingatha seeleson ezi-8.
k-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ii-lesson ezi-3 zomhlobo wakho nala manani mabini.
k-06.s.s1.r.a: Imbuyekezo epheleleyo isebenza kuphela phambi kokuba ikhosi iqale. Umhlobo wakho sele ebe kwii-lesson ezi-3.
k-06.s.s1.r.b: Izibini kwezithathu zisebenza phambi kokuba ingxenye yesithathu yeelesson idlule. 3 kwi-8 ngaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu (malunga ne-2.7).
k-06.s.s1.r.d: Akukho mbuyekezo isebenza kuphela emva kokuba isiqingatha (4 kwi-8) sidlulile. Umhlobo wakho ube nezi-3 kuphela.
k-06.s.s1.explain: 3 kwii-lesson ezi-8 ngaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu (8 ÷ 3 ≈ 2.7) kodwa ngaphantsi kwesiqingatha (4). Ngoko umqolo othi 'phambi kokuba isiqingatha sidlule' uyasebenza: imbuyekezo yesiqingatha.
k-06.s.s2.prompt: Ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi obuwafuna ukufikelela kuloo mpendulo?
k-06.s.s2.r.c: Oko kuthi kuphela indlela yokufaka isicelo, hayi ukuba kubuyiselwa kangakanani.
k-06.s.s2.explain: Itafile inika amaqhezu eekosi ezipheleleyo, ngoko udinga isixa (8) nenani lezo sele bezifundile (3). Indlela yokufaka isicelo nesizathu azifuneki kwisixa.
k-06.s.s2.acc.0: Ukwazi indlela yokufaka isicelo kuluncedo kwinyathelo elilandelayo, kodwa akutshintshi isixa sembuyekezo.
k-06.s.s3.prompt: Phendula umhlobo wakho ngesiKorea: yitsho ukuba imbuyekezo ingakanani, nika isizathu esivela kumanani, umxelele ekufuneka akwenze ngokulandelayo. Intetho eqhelekileyo okanye enembeko zombini zilungile.
k-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nika impendulo kuqala, emva koko isizathu ngamanani.
k-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndithe kutheni isisiqingatha, hayi epheleleyo okanye engekho?

k-07.title: Isicelo esinye, abamameli ababini
k-07.goal: Gweba ukuba loluphi isicelo kuprofesa ngumyalelo kunesicelo esithambileyo, uze ubhale isicelo esifanayo kuprofesa nakumhlobo osondeleyo.
k-07.material: Ugule kwaye wasilela iklasi yoLwesibini. Udinga ii-slide zesifundo. Uza kubuza uprofesa wakho ngomyalezo, kwaye ubuze nomfundi osebenza naye ongumhlobo osondeleyo oneminyaka efanayo.
k-07.thinking.2: Ukubhala kwakhona intsingiselo efanayo kumamkeli owahlukileyo
k-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zozine zisemthethweni ngethoni, ngoko thelekisa enye into: umyalezo ngamnye ubuza okanye uyalela?
k-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba uprofesa ufunda umyalezo ngamnye: sesiphi esivakala njengomyalelo?
k-07.s.s1.r.a: Oku kuyafaneleka: '-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?' ngumbuzo othambileyo ushiya uprofesa nendawo yokuthi hayi.
k-07.s.s1.r.c: Oku kuyafaneleka: kubuza ukuba kunokwenzeka kunokuxelela uprofesa ukuba enze into.
k-07.s.s1.r.d: Oku kuyafaneleka: '-(으)시면 감사하겠습니다' yindlela eqhelekileyo esemthethweni yokwenza isicelo.
k-07.s.s1.explain: b ixelela uprofesa into ekufuneka ayenze ('보내세요') yongeza ixesha lokugqibela ('오늘 안에 꼭'); ngumyalelo. Ezinye ziyabuza, zishiya uprofesa ekhululekile ukuphendula.
k-07.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wakho kuprofesa ucela ii-slide. Yitsho ukuba kutheni wasilela iklasi.
k-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa imo yombuzo efana ne-'-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?' ukuthamba.
k-07.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku buza umhlobo wakho osondeleyo (iminyaka efanayo, usebenzisa 반말) into efanayo.
k-07.s.s3.hint.0: Yenza isivakalisi sifutshane uze usiphelise ngokuqhelekileyo.
k-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Oku kuvakala njengokuthetha nomhlobo, hayi uprofesa?

k-08.title: Isimemo esingazange sibe sesinye
k-08.goal: Fumana umgca apho umbulelo wathathwa njengesimemo sokwenene, chaza indlela umamelwane aphendule ngayo, uze ulungise impendulo.
k-08.material:
Udibana nomamelwane kwi-elevator. Nibulelana ngamanye amaxesha kodwa anisondelelanga.

Incoko:
k-08.s.s1.prompt: Incoko yaba nzima. Khetha umgca owenza inxalenye yesizathu: ibinzana elinokufundwa ngeendlela ezimbini, impendulo eyenza ibe licebo, okanye ukulandelela okucinezela icebo kwakhona.
k-08.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana umgca wokuqala apho omnye umntu ecacile ngakumbi komnye.
k-08.s.s1.hint.1: Buza: kukho ixesha okanye indawo kwisivakalisi somamelwane ngokwakhe?
k-08.s.s1.explain: '언제 밥 한번 먹어요' (umgca 3) rhoqo libinzana elibubele lokuvala, njenge-'masityeni isidlo sasemini ngolunye usuku'. Umgca 4 uyiphatha njengecebo elithe ngqo uze useta umhla. Ukuthandabuza komamelwane (…, 글쎄요, 나중에) kubonisa uxinzelelo. Umgca 6 ('그럼 다음 주는요? 몇 시가 좋아요?') ucinezela icebo kwakhona emva kokuba umamelwane ethandabuzile.
k-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kukho ixesha okanye indawo kwisivakalisi somamelwane?
k-08.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ngendlela abantu bagqiba ngayo incoko emfutshane kwi-elevator.
k-08.s.s2.o.a: Ukuthi 'masitye ngolunye usuku' bekungumbulelo onobubele, kwaye umhla omiselweyo uvakala njengoxinzelelo.
k-08.s.s2.r.b: Akukho nto kwincoko ethi oko. Umamelwane uhlala enembeko kuyo yonke.
k-08.s.s2.r.c: Kunokwenzeka, kodwa umamelwane owayefuna ukudibana ngokwenene wayeya kucebisa olunye usuku; ithoni ethandabuzayo, engazibophelelanga ihambelana ngakumbi nombulelo.
k-08.s.s2.explain: Amagama afanayo anokuba sisimemo sokwenene okanye umbulelo. Ithoni nemeko (asisondele, kwi-elevator, akukho xesha likhankanyiweyo) zikhomba kumbulelo apha.
k-08.s.s2.acc.0: Kunokuba yinyani ukuba umamelwane uxakekile, kodwa ithoni ethandabuzayo ichazwa ngcono ngumbulelo.
k-08.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo engcono ku-'네. 언제 밥 한번 먹어요.' ebubele kodwa engamiseli mhla.
k-08.s.s3.hint.0: Vuma ngendlela ngokubanzi ngaphandle kokubiza usuku okanye ixesha.
k-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Impendulo yam ishiya umamelwane ekhululekile ukuthi ewe kamva?

k-09.title: Ingaphuma ngokuhlwa?
k-09.goal: Funda isaziso sesakhiwo esinoluhlu olufana netafile, gqiba ukuba leyiphi inyani engekhoyo etshintsha impendulo, jonga umkhondo wempendulo, uze ubhale impendulo ephelele kumamelwane omtsha.
k-09.thinking.0: Ukugqiba ukuba loluphi ulwazi olungekhoyo olutshintsha impendulo
k-09.s.s1.prompt: Ukunika impendulo ENYE echanekileyo ku-'Ndingaziphumisa ngokuhlwa?', yimuphi umbuzo ekufuneka umbuze umamelwane kuqala?
k-09.s.s1.hint.0: Dlula kwinto nganye (박스, 소파, 페트병) ubuze: impendulo yangokuhlwa icacile sele?
k-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kwesiphi isinto impendulo ixhomekeke kwinkcukacha umamelwane angayinikanga?
k-09.s.s1.r.b: Nayiphi na impendulo, usofa ayinakuphuma ngokuhlwa (ukuqokelelwa kungoLwesine). Ungacebisa ukuxela ngaphandle kokubuza.
k-09.s.s1.r.d: Iibhotile zinokuphuma ngokuhlwa nakuba kunjalo; ungamxelela nje umamelwane azikhuphe kwaye azihlambe.
k-09.s.s1.explain: Iphepha liphuma ngoLwesibini (ngokuhlwa kulungile), kodwa i-Styrofoam ngoLwesithathu (hayi ngokuhlwa). '박스' yodwa ayixeleli ukuba yeyiphi. Ungaphendula zombini iimeko kanye, kodwa le yeyona nyani etshintsha impendulo; usofa yi-'hayi' nakweyiphi.
k-09.s.s2.prompt: Impendulo yocwangciso yabhalwa ngesaziso. Khetha umgca ongalunganga.
k-09.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga umgca ngamnye ngokuchasene nomqolo ohambelanayo wetafile.
k-09.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga umqolo we-대형 폐기물: nini nangayiphi indlela?
k-09.s.s2.explain: Inkunkuma enkulu (소파) kufuneka ixelwe kuqala kwaye ibekwe ngosuku lokuqokelelwa, ngoLwesine phambi kwe-7 ekuseni, ne-sticker incanyathiselwe. Ayinakuphuma ngokuhlwa.
k-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo kumamelwane wakho omtsha (intetho enembeko) ezibandakanya zonke izinto ezintathu.
k-09.s.s3.hint.0: Thatha izinto enye ngenye: 페트병, 박스, 소파.
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndinike imeko yebhokisi endaweni yokuqikelela?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ithoni yam inobuhlobo kumamelwane omtsha?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.3: Ngaba ndikhankanye ukuba isofa kufuneka ixelwe kuqala eofisini kwaye ibe nesitikha?

k-11.title: Ukuthi hayi kwizimemo ezimbini
k-11.goal: Khetha ukwala okuyamkelekayo komphathi, emva koko ubhale ukwala komphathi nokwahlukileyo kozalwa naye ekwinqanaba elifanayo.
k-11.material:
Namhlanje unolunye utyelelo. Izimemo ezimbini zifikile.

팀장님: "오늘 저녁에 다 같이 회식하려고 하는데, 시간 되는 사람은 같이 가요."
입사 동기 (ozalwa naye owajoyina ngaxeshanye nawe, umhlobo osondeleyo): "오늘 퇴근하고 치킨 먹을래?"
k-11.thinking.0: Ukugweba isimbo sentetho somphathi nomntu ofanayo
k-11.thinking.1: Ukubhala ukwala okuthambileyo kunesizathu nenye indlela
k-11.thinking.2: Ukuphinda ubhale ukwala okufanayo kubaphulaphuli abahlukeneyo
k-11.s.s1.prompt: Zeziphi iindlela zokwala onokuzithumela ku-팀장님? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo kule meko.
k-11.s.s1.hint.0: Kumyalezo ngamnye, phawula ukuba ucela uxolo okanye ubonisa ukuzisola, unika isizathu, kwaye uthambisa ngento efana ne-'-ㄹ 것 같습니다'.
k-11.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha yonke imiyalezo eyenza ubuncinane izinto ezimbini kuzo ngendlela umphathi anokuyamkela ngayo.
k-11.s.s1.r.a: Ifanelekile (uxolo, isizathu, isithambisi). Ayiyiyo kuphela efanelekileyo, ngoko hlola nezinye iinketho.
k-11.s.s1.r.b: Isiphelo sisemthethweni, kodwa umyalezo yintetho nje: akukho xolo, akukho kuzisola kwaye akukho kuthambisa ('안 갑니다' yi-'andiyi' etyaba), nto leyo engaphezulu kakhulu komphathi.
k-11.s.s1.r.c: Ifanelekile (ukuzisola, isizathu, isemthethweni). Ayiyiyo kuphela efanelekileyo, ngoko hlola nezinye iinketho.
k-11.s.s1.r.d: Ifanelekile (isizathu, isithambisi, isithembiso ngexesha elizayo). Ayiyiyo kuphela efanelekileyo, ngoko hlola nezinye iinketho.
k-11.s.s1.explain: a no-c bacela uxolo okanye babonisa ukuzisola ('죄송하지만', '아쉽지만'), banika isizathu kwaye bathambisa ukwala. d inika isizathu, ithambisa nge-'못 갈 것 같습니다' kwaye ithembisa ixesha elizayo. b ibeka kuphela ukwala okutyaba ('안 갑니다') ngoko ivakala ingenanceba nangona isiphelo sayo sisemthethweni.
k-11.s.s1.acc.0: Zombini ziyafaneleka; d iyongeza isithembiso sexesha elizayo, ngoko ukukhetha zontathu yeyona mpendulo ipheleleyo.
k-11.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ukwala kwakho ku-팀장님. Sebenzisa intetho enentlonipho/esemthethweni, uyithambise, unike isizathu uze ukhankanye ixesha elizayo.
k-11.s.s2.hint.0: Vula ngoxolo okanye enkosi, emva koko isizathu.
k-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba 팀장님 wayeva ehlonitshwa kwaye engaliwanga?
k-11.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku yala isimemo sika-동기 sechicken ngentetho engekho semthethweni. Gcina inobuhlobo uphakamise elinye ixesha.
